_comment: nature-was-a-gift's SOUND — the doorframe into nice_ron (E minor, 140). No drum, no groove: the line gets the whole room. boxforest IS theGodInUrhead's boxtoforest, the music box already walking nice_ron's bell cell out of the ward; meadowhush is nice_ron's softpad held on its first chord. towardmeadow lands on nice_ron's exact opening [e3,g3,b3] and fades, while meadowbell (nice_ron's belltale) takes the box's phrase over — the last thing you hear is the next song's own voice. Overrides cookbook default; uses only these four.
